mapper.sql: select s.shop_code, s.shop_name, s.province, s.city, s.district, s.address, s.telephone, s.description, s.image_url, s.status, su.user_code as member_user_code, su.dept_id, su.job_no, null as job_name, group_concat(distinct r.role_key order by r.role_sort separator ',') as role_codes, group_concat(distinct r.role_name order by r.role_sort separator ',') as role_names from sys_shop_user su join s_m_shop s on s.shop_code = su.shop_code left join sys_shop_user_role sur on sur.shop_code = su.shop_code and sur.user_code = su.user_code left join sys_role r on r.role_code = sur.role_code and r.shop_code = su.shop_code and r.role_type = 'TENANT' and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: where su.user_code = #{userCode} and su.status = '0' and su.del_flag = '0' and s.status = 1 group by s.shop_code, s.shop_name, s.province, s.city, s.district, s.address, s.telephone, s.description, s.image_url, s.status, su.user_code, su.dept_id, su.job_no order by s.createtime, s.shop_code

where su.user_code = #{userCode} and su.shop_code = #{shopCode} and su.status = '0' and su.del_flag = '0' and s.status = 1 group by s.shop_code, s.shop_name, s.province, s.city, s.district, s.address, s.telephone, s.description, s.image_url, s.status, su.user_code, su.dept_id, su.job_no limit 1

select distinct r.role_code, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.menu_check_strictly, r.dept_check_strictly, r.status, r.del_flag from sys_shop_user_role sur join sys_shop_user su on su.shop_code = sur.shop_code and su.user_code = sur.user_code and su.status = '0' and su.del_flag = '0' join sys_role r on r.role_code = sur.role_code and r.shop_code = sur.shop_code where sur.shop_code = #{shopCode} and sur.user_code = #{userCode} and r.role_type = 'TENANT' and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' order by r.role_sort, r.role_code

select count(1) from sys_shop_user_role sur join sys_shop_user su on su.shop_code = sur.shop_code and su.user_code = sur.user_code and su.status = '0' and su.del_flag = '0' join sys_role r on r.role_code = sur.role_code and r.shop_code = sur.shop_code where sur.shop_code = #{shopCode} and sur.user_code = #{userCode} and r.role_type = 'TENANT' and r.system_flag = 1 and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0'

select distinct r.role_key from sys_shop_user_role sur join sys_shop_user su on su.shop_code = sur.shop_code and su.user_code = sur.user_code and su.status = '0' and su.del_flag = '0' join sys_role r on r.role_code = sur.role_code and r.shop_code = sur.shop_code where sur.shop_code = #{shopCode} and sur.user_code = #{userCode} and r.role_type = 'TENANT' and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' order by r.role_key

select distinct m.perms from sys_shop_user_role sur join sys_shop_user su on su.shop_code = sur.shop_code and su.user_code = sur.user_code and su.status = '0' and su.del_flag = '0' join sys_role r on r.role_code = sur.role_code and r.shop_code = sur.shop_code join sys_role_menu rm on rm.role_code = r.role_code join sys_menu m on m.fun_code = rm.fun_code join sys_shop_menu sm on sm.shop_code = sur.shop_code and sm.fun_code = m.fun_code and sm.status = '0' where sur.shop_code = #{shopCode} and sur.user_code = #{userCode} and r.role_type = 'TENANT' and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' and m.status = '0' and m.perms is not null and m.perms != ''
and (m.perms like 'tenant:%' or m.perms like 'purchase:%' or m.perms like 'inventory:%' or m.perms like 'production:%' or m.perms like 'finance:%' or m.perms like 'order:%' or m.perms like 'site:%' or m.perms like 'price:%' or m.perms like 'dashboard:%') order by m.perms

select distinct m.perms from sys_shop_menu sm join sys_menu m on m.fun_code = sm.fun_code where sm.shop_code = #{shopCode} and sm.status = '0' and m.status = '0' and m.perms is not null and m.perms != '' and (m.perms like 'tenant:%' or m.perms like 'purchase:%' or m.perms like 'inventory:%' or m.perms like 'production:%' or m.perms like 'finance:%' or m.perms like 'order:%' or m.perms like 'site:%' or m.perms like 'price:%' or m.perms like 'dashboard:%') order by m.perms

select distinct m.fun_code from sys_shop_user_role sur join sys_shop_user su on su.shop_code = sur.shop_code and su.user_code = sur.user_code and su.status = '0' and su.del_flag = '0' join sys_role r on r.role_code = sur.role_code and r.shop_code = sur.shop_code join sys_role_menu rm on rm.role_code = r.role_code join sys_menu m on m.fun_code = rm.fun_code join sys_shop_menu sm on sm.shop_code = sur.shop_code and sm.fun_code = m.fun_code and sm.status = '0' where sur.shop_code = #{shopCode} and sur.user_code = #{userCode} and r.role_type = 'TENANT' and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' and m.status = '0'
select distinct m.fun_code from sys_shop_menu sm join sys_menu m on m.fun_code = sm.fun_code where sm.shop_code = #{shopCode} and sm.status = '0' and m.status = '0' order by m.fun_code

select distinct m.fun_code, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.`query`, m.route_name, m.visible, m.status, ifnull(m.perms, '') as perms, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num from sys_shop_user_role sur join sys_shop_user su on su.shop_code = sur.shop_code and su.user_code = sur.user_code and su.status = '0' and su.del_flag = '0' join sys_role r on r.role_code = sur.role_code and r.shop_code = sur.shop_code join sys_role_menu rm on rm.role_code = r.role_code join sys_menu m on m.fun_code = rm.fun_code join sys_shop_menu sm on sm.shop_code = sur.shop_code and sm.fun_code = m.fun_code and sm.status = '0' where sur.shop_code = #{shopCode} and sur.user_code = #{userCode} and r.role_type = 'TENANT' and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' and m.menu_type in ('M', 'C') and m.status = '0' order by m.parent_id, m.order_num

select distinct m.fun_code, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.`query`, m.route_name, m.visible, m.status, ifnull(m.perms, '') as perms, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num from sys_shop_menu sm join sys_menu m on m.fun_code = sm.fun_code where sm.shop_code = #{shopCode} and sm.status = '0' and m.menu_type in ('M', 'C') and m.status = '0' order by m.parent_id, m.order_num

select s.shop_code, s.shop_name, s.status as shop_status, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.status as role_status, admin_user.user_code as admin_user_code, admin_user.user_name as admin_user_name, admin_user.nick_name as admin_nick_name, admin_user.phonenumber as admin_phonenumber, admin_user.status as admin_status from s_m_shop s join sys_role r on r.shop_code = s.shop_code left join sys_shop_user admin_member on admin_member.shop_code = s.shop_code and admin_member.is_owner = 1 and admin_member.status = '0' and admin_member.del_flag = '0' and admin_member.user_code <> 'us1' left join sys_shop_user_role admin_relation on admin_relation.shop_code = admin_member.shop_code and admin_relation.user_code = admin_member.user_code and admin_relation.role_code = r.role_code left join sys_user admin_user on admin_user.user_code = admin_relation.user_code and admin_user.del_flag = '0' where r.role_type = 'TENANT' and r.system_flag = 1 and r.del_flag = '0' order by s.createtime, s.shop_code

select s.shop_code, s.shop_name, s.status as shop_status, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.status as role_status, admin_user.user_code as admin_user_code, admin_user.user_name as admin_user_name, admin_user.nick_name as admin_nick_name, admin_user.phonenumber as admin_phonenumber, admin_user.status as admin_status from sys_role r join s_m_shop s on s.shop_code = r.shop_code left join sys_shop_user admin_member on admin_member.shop_code = s.shop_code and admin_member.is_owner = 1 and admin_member.status = '0' and admin_member.del_flag = '0' and admin_member.user_code <> 'us1' left join sys_shop_user_role admin_relation on admin_relation.shop_code = admin_member.shop_code and admin_relation.user_code = admin_member.user_code and admin_relation.role_code = r.role_code left join sys_user admin_user on admin_user.user_code = admin_relation.user_code and admin_user.del_flag = '0' where r.role_code = #{roleCode} and r.role_type = 'TENANT' and r.system_flag = 1 and r.del_flag = '0' limit 1

with recursive assignable_menu as ( select m.fun_code, m.parent_id from sys_menu m where m.status = '0' and (m.perms like 'tenant:%' or m.perms like 'purchase:%' or m.perms like 'inventory:%' or m.perms like 'production:%' or m.perms like 'finance:%' or m.perms like 'order:%' or m.perms like 'site:%' or m.perms like 'price:%' or m.perms like 'dashboard:%') union distinct select parent.fun_code, parent.parent_id from sys_menu parent join assignable_menu child on child.parent_id = parent.fun_code where parent.status = '0' ) select rm.fun_code from sys_role_menu rm join sys_role r on r.role_code = rm.role_code join sys_menu m on m.fun_code = rm.fun_code where r.role_code = #{roleCode} and r.role_type = 'TENANT' and r.system_flag = 1 and r.del_flag = '0' and m.fun_code in (select fun_code from assignable_menu) order by rm.fun_code

with recursive assignable_menu as ( select m.fun_code, m.parent_id from sys_menu m where m.status = '0' and (m.perms like 'tenant:%' or m.perms like 'purchase:%' or m.perms like 'inventory:%' or m.perms like 'production:%' or m.perms like 'finance:%' or m.perms like 'order:%' or m.perms like 'site:%' or m.perms like 'price:%' or m.perms like 'dashboard:%') union distinct select parent.fun_code, parent.parent_id from sys_menu parent join assignable_menu child on child.parent_id = parent.fun_code where parent.status = '0' ) select m.fun_code, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.`query`, m.route_name, m.visible, m.status, ifnull(m.perms, '') as perms, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num from sys_menu m join assignable_menu scoped on scoped.fun_code = m.fun_code order by m.parent_id, m.order_num, m.fun_code
mapper.delete: delete rm from sys_role_menu rm inner join sys_role r on r.role_code = rm.role_code where r.role_code = #{roleCode} and r.role_type = 'TENANT' and r.system_flag = 1 and r.del_flag = '0'

with recursive business_menu as ( select m.fun_code, m.parent_id from sys_menu m where m.perms like 'purchase:%' or m.perms like 'inventory:%' or m.perms like 'production:%' or m.perms like 'finance:%' or m.perms like 'order:%' or m.perms like 'site:%' or m.perms like 'price:%' or m.perms like 'dashboard:%' union distinct select parent.fun_code, parent.parent_id from sys_menu parent join business_menu child on child.parent_id = parent.fun_code where parent.status = '0' ), tenant_menu as ( select m.fun_code, m.parent_id from sys_menu m where m.status = '0' and m.perms like 'tenant:%' union distinct select parent.fun_code, parent.parent_id from sys_menu parent join tenant_menu child on child.parent_id = parent.fun_code where parent.status = '0' ) delete from sys_shop_menu where shop_code = #{shopCode} and fun_code in (select fun_code from business_menu) and fun_code not in (select fun_code from tenant_menu)
mapper.insert:
insert into sys_shop_menu(shop_code, fun_code, status, create_by, create_time) with recursive business_menu as ( select m.fun_code, m.parent_id from sys_menu m where m.status = '0' and (m.perms like 'purchase:%' or m.perms like 'inventory:%' or m.perms like 'production:%' or m.perms like 'finance:%' or m.perms like 'order:%' or m.perms like 'site:%' or m.perms like 'price:%' or m.perms like 'dashboard:%') union distinct select parent.fun_code, parent.parent_id from sys_menu parent join business_menu child on child.parent_id = parent.fun_code where parent.status = '0' ) select #{shopCode}, m.fun_code, '0', #{operator}, sysdate() from sys_menu m join business_menu scoped on scoped.fun_code = m.fun_code and m.fun_code in
#{funCode}
mapper.select: select min(dept_id) from sys_dept where shop_code = #{shopCode} and parent_id = 0 and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into sys_shop_user(shop_code, user_code, dept_id, status, is_owner, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values(#{shopCode}, #{userCode}, #{deptId}, '0', 1, '0', #{operator}, sysdate(), #{operator}, sysdate()) on duplicate key update dept_id = values(dept_id), status = '0', is_owner = 1, del_flag = '0', update_by = values(update_by), update_time = values(update_time)
mapper.update: update sys_shop_user set is_owner = 0, status = '1', update_by = #{operator}, update_time = sysdate() where shop_code = #{shopCode} and user_code <> #{userCode} and user_code <> 'us1' and is_owner = 1 and del_flag = '0'

update sys_user set user_name = #{userName}, nick_name = #{nickName}, phonenumber = #{phonenumber}, status = #{status},
password = #{password}, pwd_update_date = sysdate(),
update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where user_code = #{userCode} and user_code <> 'us1' and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select shop_code, shop_name, province, city, district, address, telephone, description, image_url, status from s_m_shop where shop_code = #{shopCode} and status <> -1 limit 1
select shop_code, shop_name, province, city, district, address, telephone, description, image_url, console_url, status from s_m_shop where shop_code = #{shopCode} and status <> -1 limit 1
select console_url from s_m_shop where shop_code = #{shopCode} and status <> -1 limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into s_m_shop(shop_code, shop_name, province, city, district, address, telephone, description, image_url, console_url, status, createtime, updatetime) values(#{shopCode}, #{shopName}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{address}, #{telephone}, #{description}, #{imageUrl}, #{consoleUrl}, #{status}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.update: update s_m_shop set shop_name = #{shop.shopName}, province = #{shop.province}, city = #{shop.city}, district = #{shop.district}, address = #{shop.address}, telephone = #{shop.telephone}, description = #{shop.description}, image_url = #{shop.imageUrl}, console_url = #{shop.consoleUrl}, status = #{shop.status}, updatetime = sysdate() where shop_code = #{shopCode} and status <> -1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_dept(shop_code, parent_id, ancestors, dept_name, order_num, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time) values(#{shopCode}, 0, '0', #{deptName}, 0, '0', '0', #{operator}, sysdate())

insert into sys_role(role_code, shop_code, role_type, system_flag, role_name, role_key, role_sort, data_scope, menu_check_strictly, dept_check_strictly, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{roleCode}, #{shopCode}, 'TENANT', 1, '商家管理员', #{roleKey}, 1, '1', 1, 1, '0', '0', #{operator}, sysdate(), '平台创建的内置商家管理员角色')

insert into sys_shop_menu(shop_code, fun_code, status, create_by, create_time) select #{shopCode}, m.fun_code, '0', #{operator}, sysdate() from sys_menu m where m.status = '0' and (m.perms like 'tenant:%' or m.perms like 'purchase:%' or m.perms like 'inventory:%' or m.perms like 'production:%' or m.perms like 'finance:%' or m.perms like 'order:%' or m.perms like 'site:%' or m.perms like 'price:%' or m.perms like 'dashboard:%' or m.fun_code in ( select distinct child.parent_id from sys_menu child where child.status = '0' and (child.perms like 'tenant:%' or child.perms like 'purchase:%' or child.perms like 'inventory:%' or child.perms like 'production:%' or child.perms like 'finance:%' or child.perms like 'order:%' or child.perms like 'site:%' or child.perms like 'price:%' or child.perms like 'dashboard:%') ))

insert into sys_role_menu(role_code, fun_code) select #{roleCode}, m.fun_code from sys_menu m where m.status = '0' and (m.perms like 'tenant:%' or m.perms like 'purchase:%' or m.perms like 'inventory:%' or m.perms like 'production:%' or m.perms like 'finance:%' or m.perms like 'order:%' or m.perms like 'site:%' or m.perms like 'price:%' or m.perms like 'dashboard:%')

insert into sys_shop_user(shop_code, user_code, dept_id, status, is_owner, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values(#{shopCode}, #{userCode}, #{deptId}, '0', 0, '0', #{operator}, sysdate(), #{operator}, sysdate())
insert into sys_shop_user_role(shop_code, user_code, role_code, create_by, create_time) values(#{shopCode}, #{userCode}, #{roleCode}, #{operator}, sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete rm from sys_role_menu rm inner join sys_role r on r.role_code = rm.role_code where r.shop_code = #{shopCode} and r.role_type = 'TENANT'
delete rd from sys_role_dept rd inner join sys_role r on r.role_code = rd.role_code where r.shop_code = #{shopCode} and r.role_type = 'TENANT'
delete from sys_role where shop_code = #{shopCode} and role_type = 'TENANT'
